# Town Building Systems

> > A 40+ year established insulation and weatherization contractor serving Buffalo, NY and Western New York with residential and commercial solutions.

Town Building Systems is a regional contractor specializing in insulation, weatherization, energy efficiency, and gutter installation services across Buffalo, Erie County, Niagara County, and Western New York. The company is backed by parent company Installed Building Products (IBP) and emphasizes employee benefits, safety programs, and community engagement through the IBP Foundation.
